meta.name: game-dev
meta.description: Parent skill for all game development work. Routes to the right sub-skill based on what you need. Invoke this instead of remembering 14 individual game dev skills.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需直达对应的游戏开发子技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做游戏开发,却不知该用哪个细分技能
copy.tagline_en: Route to the right game development sub-skill for your need
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop games and want to pick the right specialized skill quickly

howto.what: 装上后,你提游戏开发需求时,Claude 会先判断它属于哪类工作,再把任务路由到对应的子技能(如规划冲刺、把关范围、写设计文档等),而不是直接泛泛回答。
howto.when: 当你说要做游戏开发相关工作(如规划开发、写设计文档、准备发布等),或提到其中任一环节时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划这周的开发冲刺
say.note: 会调用 sprint-manager 子技能来安排任务。

say.text: 评估一下这个游戏创意值不值得做
say.note: 会调用 scope-guardian 来把关范围。
会调用 gdd-writer 来起草。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude first identifies the kind of game-dev task you're describing, then routes it to the matching sub-skill (e.g., sprint planning, scope guarding, GDD writing) instead of answering generically.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention game development work—such as planning, designing, or publishing—or any stage tied to the 14 sub-skills.

say_en.text: Help me plan this week's dev sprint.
Should I build this game idea?
